metadata.purpose: Help Decide9ja respond to viral misinformation

fact_checking_organizations.name: Africa Check
fact_checking_organizations.focus: Verifying facts, promoting accuracy across Africa

claims_2024.claim: Bola Tinubu forged his university degree
claims_2024.summary: Investigation found no evidence to support forgery allegations. Won 2024 African Fact-Checking Award.
claims_2024.why_it_matters: Core attack on president's legitimacy used throughout election and post-election period

claims_2024.claim: Ibrahim Babangida warned Tinubu of impending military coup
claims_2024.summary: Baseless claim with no supporting evidence

claims_2024.claim: Donald Trump said US could capture Tinubu within 24 hours
claims_2024.summary: Fabricated quote, no record of Trump making this statement
claims_2024.why_it_matters: Exploits US-Nigeria relations and anti-government sentiment

claims_2024.claim: UK Prime Minister made corruption allegations about Nigeria

claims_2023.claim: INEC servers showed Peter Obi won the election
claims_2023.summary: INEC does not have servers that tabulate results centrally; IReV is a viewing portal only

claims_2023.claim: Nigerian elections had massive vote manipulation via BVAS
claims_2023.summary: BVAS technical issues documented but claims of systematic manipulation unverified

claims_2023.claim: Tinubu is ineligible to run due to age/citizenship issues
claims_2023.summary: Supreme Court upheld Tinubu's election, rejecting eligibility challenges
claims_2023.why_it_matters: Fundamental legitimacy question resolved by courts
